children: Integra LifeSciences furnished an updated investor presentation detailing remediation progress, Braintree facility start-up and LTM Q2 2026 financials.
Updated investor presentation provided as Exhibit 99.1, used with lenders on plans to refinance senior credit facility in 2026.
LTM Q2 2026 revenue $1,648M (up 1.6% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA $337M (up 11.8% YoY), 20.5% adjusted EBITDA margin.
Braintree, MA site became operational in Q2 2026; on track to generate commercial revenue and support SurgiMend relaunch in Q4 2026.
Company reports all warning letter commitments on track for completion in 2026 and remediation activities largely to be implemented by year-end.
Free cash flow improvement: YoY FCF growth of $57M and net leverage improved to 4.1x (LTM Q2 2026) with target 2.5–3.5x.
